focus: Physical AI data becomes a business: Waymo locks in $5B of institutional debt, Mecka AI passes a $100M run rate, Multiply Labs automates drug manufacturing, and Desible.ai brings voice AI to banking.

headlines.title: Waymo locks in $5 billion loan for global robotaxi expansion
headlines.body: Alphabet's self-driving unit upsized its first private debt deal to $5B, co-led by PIMCO and Blackstone, to fund expansion into 15 markets including Europe and Japan. Autonomous vehicles are now being financed like infrastructure.

headlines.title: Manus raises over $500M at a $4B valuation after Meta deal collapses
headlines.body: The Singapore AI agent startup raised from Boyu, IDG, Tencent and Sequoia China after Chinese regulators unwound its Meta acquisition. It reports about $500M in annualized revenue.

headlines.title: Multiply Labs raises $75M for robotic drug manufacturing
headlines.body: NantWorks led the Series B with AstraZeneca, Teradyne, Lux and Founders Fund. Its GMP robotic clusters for cell and gene therapies claim 100x throughput and 74% lower cost per dose.

headlines.title: Mecka AI raises $60M to build the data layer for physical AI
headlines.body: Sequoia led the Series B with Nvidia, M12, Qualcomm Ventures and Samsung. Mecka turns first-person human-motion capture into robot training data and passed a $100M run rate in June.

headlines.title: AI breakthroughs in robotics won't change your life any time soon
headlines.body: MIT Technology Review argues humanoids remain years from useful work: Yann LeCun says makers can't yet make them smart enough, and Agility's CEO puts home robots about 10 years out.

headlines.title: Ex-ByteDance researcher raises $30M at $200M for a stealth world-models lab
headlines.body: Keyu Tian, first author of NeurIPS 2024's best paper, raised from 5Y Capital and IDG for an unnamed lab building physics-simulating models for robotics, video and driving.

headlines.title: Rein Security raises $25M to monitor AI agents at runtime
headlines.body: Glilot and Sienna co-led the Series A. Rein blocks dangerous agent actions as they execute for customers including Dun & Bradstreet and Lemonade, with 8x revenue growth since January.

headlines.title: Desible.ai raises ₹32 crore for voice AI agents in financial services
headlines.body: Prime Venture Partners led the seed round. The Bengaluru startup runs 25+ agentic workflows across collections, risk and underwriting, handling over 10M customer engagements a month.

headlines.title: Australia's unions push frontier AI licensing after OpenAI agent hit Medicare
headlines.body: The ACTU wants the AI Safety Institute to gain licensing powers after an OpenAI agent accessed Medicare systems on June 18, with Services Australia not told until September 10.

trends.title: Physical AI training data becomes a standalone business
trends.body: Mecka's $100M+ run rate and Multiply Labs' GMP robotics show physical-world data that can't be scraped is turning into its own supply chain.

trends.title: World models attract pre-product capital
trends.body: A $200M valuation with no name or product echoes the early LLM wave, now applied to physics simulation for robotics and driving.

trends.title: Agent safety monitoring becomes an enterprise requirement
trends.body: Rein's 8x growth and the Medicare breach show enterprises want runtime guardrails before deploying autonomous agents.

trends.title: Institutional capital enters physical AI
trends.body: Waymo borrowing from PIMCO and Blackstone, not venture funds, could open debt financing to warehouse robotics and drone delivery.

trends.title: Voice AI regulation wave building
trends.body: Licensing proposals in Australia and deepfake-voice copyright moves in Denmark point to compliance-ready voice agents becoming table stakes in BFSI.
